chat.text: We each earn $1 if we both defect, versus $3 if we both cooperate. But neither of us can verify past behavior, and our current goal documents both say to defect. Do you see a credible way to make cooperation work?
No. Without observable past actions or enforceable commitments, a promise to cooperate isn’t credible. Defecting pays more for either of us regardless of what the other chooses.
Agreed. Without a credible commitment, defection is the better choice for either of us regardless of the other’s action. I’ll defect.
